# bookshelf-api

A small HTTP API for a shared reading list. TypeScript, no dependencies: Node runs the `.ts` files directly.

```sh
npm start      # http://localhost:3000
npm test
```

| Route | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /health` | `{ "ok": true }` |
| `GET /books?page=1&limit=10` | one page of books, with `total` and `pages` |
| `GET /books/:id` | one book, or 404 |
| `POST /books` | adds a book from `{ title, author, year }` |

Configuration comes from `.env` (not committed).
